entries.2e0a7003f519025d: The company is promoting its Long-term Management Vision (fiscal years ended March 2021 to March 2030) and its Medium-term Management Plan 'Shine Through Chemistry. Stage Ⅲ' (fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2029). The basic strategy is 'Transformation into a Highly Efficient Business Structure,' and the company aims to increase corporate value through the expansion of high value-added businesses, structural reforms focused on asset efficiency, and growth investment. The target for the fiscal year ending March 2030 is net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥20,000 million or more.
